groups.saying_opens: عرج بي إلى السماء وإني هبطت

notes: Layth narrates in the first person («استقبلته») and the one he met, who speaks («فقال إني لم أصل الظهر بعد»), is not named in the text: rule 11 sets needs_ruling, and that speaker is not added
Saying 2 is the answer to Layth's question («أخبرني فلان عن فلان عن عائشة»); the answerer is again unnamed, so the group goes from Layth to the two «فلان» placeholders (unnamed) and then Aisha
«أبي» occurrence 1 is the compiler's father; «علي» occurrence 1 is the brother in «عن أخيه علي» (rule 7)
